verdict.rationale: Blaxel's docs center on cloud sandboxes created and managed through its SDK, REST API and CLI using API keys. New sandboxes deploy from images "in seconds", and standby sandboxes resume in under 25ms, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: an explicit documented single create-sandbox SDK/API call example, explicit description of the isolation model (e.g. microVM boundaries), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the cold-start speed claims.
